summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of Windie static prototype completed at 1440x900 viewport. All 3-column layout, theme toggle, sidebar CRUD, chat panel rendering (roles/metadata lanes), composer (send/model-override/image-attach/streaming), inspector (metadata/active-path/system-prompt-edit/preview-toggle/tool-schemas/selected-message-actions), message row actions (fork/truncate/edit/remove), and tree overlay (nodes/edges/branch-points/detail-actions) all function as specified. Zero console errors during a full interaction run. No horizontal scroll at 1440px. Dark theme text contrast measured 7.76-19.06 (well above WCAG AA).
critical_code_review_comments: Composer send button uses conditional styling but always renders as .cursor-not-allowed border-border when empty; disabled attribute is applied correctly. OK.

forkFromMessage semantics: creates sibling under selected node's parent and repoints activePath to end with that new leaf. This effectively shortens active path when forking from mid-conversation. The spec says 'active path is extended to it' which is satisfied (the new leaf is on the active path), though it also implies extension; behavior is consistent with the tree-primitive model but could confuse users if they expect the ancestors past the fork point to remain. Consider surfacing a 'reset from here' vs 'new leaf' distinction. Non-blocking.

editMessage sets selectedNodeId to null after edit but the previously selected node id may have referred to the old node; the effect could momentarily deselect the inspector selected-message section. Consider setting to the newly-created sibling id. Minor UX.

TreeOverlay layoutTree lays nodes out purely by BFS order and depth; siblings from different subtrees can visually collide horizontally when the tree is wide because x is (position-in-depth-row * gap). For richer trees this can look tangled. Not blocking for prototype.
InspectorPanel imports Copy from lucide-react but does not use it — dead import (lint noise).

MessageRow keeps a local 'draft' state initialized from node text at mount; if the underlying node text changes (e.g., streaming), the draft won't update. Only triggered when user is editing, but worth noting.
seed_data_creation: None. In-memory mock data from mockData.js is used; 6 seeded conversations verified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All features from the review request were exercised end-to-end via Playwright at 1440x900. Fork/truncate/edit/remove all persist expected state changes. Streaming works via setTimeout (completes in ~1.6s). Model override & image attach pill toggle correctly. System prompt edit reflects immediately in chat's root SYS row. Tree overlay renders 14 nodes for conv_arch with visible 'branch points' indicator (conv_arch has 1 branch point verified). Zero console errors. Data-testids used throughout are stable. Only one nit worth mentioning: the message body area for a plain text assistant/user message does not currently have its own data-testid — text is verified via inner HTML search. Not blocking.
